_comment: Which hourly ticks deserve a full cycle. A full cycle quotes the board and may allocate; a light tick settles what is due, scores, and stops. Cost is the reason: a full board refresh is 56 HTTP requests and about four minutes of wall time, almost all of it backoff, while settling a handful of rows is a few requests.
_full_cycle_comment: Four full cycles a day, six hours apart. Positions are held for one to seven days, so quoting the board more often than that produces churn, not information. Every other tick is light.
_max_quotes_comment: Quote the deepest rows that pass strategy/venue-filters.json, not the whole board. The binding constraint on the public endpoint is latency under throttling, not the request count.
_refresh_comment: A full core/venues.py refresh is the operator's job in practice, but if the record has not been refreshed in this many cycles the agent should note it in journal/proposals.md rather than allocate on stale depth.
